title: 朝日杯FSの後に・楽しんだ横で

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky, accelerating at full throttle, enjoys the race and finishes with a good result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riding high on her accomplishment, she decides to take another step toward the Classics by running in the Spring Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Maruzensky has been enjoying her races with all of her heart…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her incredible running has become like an insurmountable wall in the eyes of other racers.
